decision: Dung mot component dung chung ForeignText o packages/ui thay vi viet tay <span lang="en"> tai cho goi nhu 5 cho hien co
impact: Doi lai them mot vat vao packages/ui va mot lop nhap moi. Loai phuong an viet tay vi no DA troi o 3 cho (MetaLine, DetailSheetProse, timeline-entry) — day la so da xay ra, khong phai lo xa; va docs/design.md bat UI dung chung song o /packages/ui

decision: Chuyen luon 5 cho viet tay hien co sang ForeignText, khong chi 4 cho moi tren tam ho so
impact: Doi lai diff cham 5 file NGOAI pham vi tam ho so da chot. Nhan downside nay co y: cau 'component dung chung la con duong duy nhat' chi do duoc khi no dung, va mot component phu 4/9 cho khong chan duoc lan troi ke tiep — ma chan troi chinh la ly do da chon co che nay. Viec chuyen la co hoc, khong doi DOM sinh ra. Nguoi duyet thay dong nay tren the Cong 1 va cat duoc

decision: KHONG khai lang=en cho o nguoi nhap duoc (contact.title) va danh tu rieng (ten cong ty, dia danh), du chung cung la gia tri tu co so du lieu hien tren trang lang=vi
impact: Doi lai pham vi hep hon cach doc rong nhat cua AC-7 vong truoc. Ly do khong phai tiet kiem cong: khai cung lang=en len o nguoi go duoc la khai SAI — 'Giam doc kinh doanh' se bi doc bang bo phat am tieng Anh, dung cai loi dang va chi nguoc chieu. WCAG 2.2 SC 3.1.2 goi ten dung hai ca nay trong ban ngoai le: proper names va words of indeterminate language. AC-5 la chieu do chong khai thua cho chinh quyet dinh nay

decision: bo design-pass — vong nay khong doi mot pixel nao, ForeignText sinh dung cay DOM ma 5 cho viet tay dang sinh
impact: Gate 1 duyet UI bang chu — mat khoanh khac visual truoc duyet. Nhan doi lai: mot phien tham my tren ban bam duoc se khong co gi de nhin, vi thay doi nay chi trinh doc man hinh nghe thay. Dac ta UX trong design-doc khai ro o muc 4: khong co thay doi thi giac nao

decision: Doi kieu MetaLine.parts tu (string|null)[] sang (string|{text,lang}|null)[] thay vi khai lang cho ca dong MetaLine
impact: Doi lai mot kieu du lieu phuc tap hon o mot component dung chung. Bat buoc vi cho goi o ho so cong ty truyen [location, company.industry] — mot danh tu rieng va mot phan loai, HAI TIENG trong cung mot mang. Chuoi tran giu nghia cu (khong khai gi) nen cho goi o ho so lien he khong phai sua mot chu nao; AC-7 chieu (b) canh dung dieu do

decision: Canh hoi quy nam cho cu bang cach CHAY LAI nguyen trang chan do cua ho so nhan-ung-dung-noi-tieng-viet, thay vi viet mot chan do man danh sach moi hoac mo lai ho so cu
impact: Loai hai duong: (a) mo lai ho so cu — chu kho da cam, va no khong can thiet vi chay lai mot cai THUOC khong phai mo lai mot LOI HUA; (b) viet chan do moi cho man danh sach — ton cong va te hon, vi thuoc moi khong chung minh duoc rang thuoc CU van xanh, ma dung cai thuoc cu moi la thu vong truoc da ky ten len. Doi lai: vong nay phu thuoc vao mot tep song trong cay ho so cua vong khac, va neu ai do xoa tep do thi E12 gay

decision: Task 9 (pha-thu) chay TUAN TU sau cung, khong gop vao lan song song voi Task 6/7/8
impact: Loai duong chay ca bon task do song song cho nhanh. Ly do: pha-thu dung ban sao cay roi chay lai chinh cac chan do kia, nen song song la hai lan do dung nhau va thuoc tinh bao do gia. Doi lai vong S3 dai them mot chang tuan tu

decision: MetaLine.parts thoi nhan union string|MetaPart, chi nhan mot hinh dang { text, lang? }; sua cau chu AC-7 (b)(c) cho khop, ghi amended_at
impact: Entry nay SAU dau niem Cong 1 — la provisional, the Cong 2 trinh rieng cho nguoi phe. Loai duong tat lint:slop bang mot dong bo qua: luat do dang noi dung (union buoc typeof o moi cho dung). Doi lai hai cho goi MetaLine phai sua hinh dang, gom ca cho o ho so ca nhan ma ban ky noi la khong phai sua. Loi hua khong doi, hinh dang moi con chat hon

decision: Bo pha thu chuyen sang chay trong mot BAN SAO git worktree rieng voi may chu dev rieng o CONG_SAO, thay vi pha tai cho tren cay dang xet; va vat thu doi tu SUA ban ghi that sang TAO ban ghi rieng roi xoa
impact: Loai hai duong ngan hon: (a) them pha-thu vao feature_loop.suite_keys cho no chay tuan tu — khong duoc, vi chinh bo kit khai lan tuan tu va lan song song chay DONG THOI; (b) chi chuyen huong tep bang chung bang bien moi truong — chua du, vi nguon van bi pha trong luc thuoc tinh doc. Doi lai: bo pha thu nang them ~1 phut dung ban sao, va phai nhan ban node_modules bang clonefile vi Turbopack tu choi symlink tro ra ngoai goc du an. Chua ba loi cung mot luc: E6/E12/lint do gia, tep bang chung bi ghi de bang so do cua ban da pha, va nguy co de lai du lieu hong trong co so du lieu dev

decision: Sua sau phat hien TRONG hop dong cua vong 2: AC-8 do ca hai ve cong doi chung duong; gia tri do doc lai TU MAY CHU thay vi hang go san; AC-6 doi QUAN HE nhap tu @crm/ui chu khong chi ten the; mien theo cap (tep, the) thay vi mien ca tep; thay ca tep chua vao git. Cong ba chuyen cua bo pha thu: cong dong, neo E9 bao tron khoi, va chan khi cay dang ban
impact: Cho doc-lai-tu-may-chu la sua mot HOI QUY do chinh ban va vong 1 gay ra: khi doi sang vat thu tu tao, gia tri do thanh hang go san trong chan do — dung cai AC-1 cam. Chan cay-ban lam bo pha thu DOI cay sach truoc khi chay, nen khong con chay tren HEAD roi bao ve cay lam viec. Doi lai: phai commit truoc khi chay bo pha thu
